T1-weighted data were classified as gray matter, white matter (WM), and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) using the unified segmentation approach
smoothed with an isotropic Gaussian kernel of 6 mm full width at half maximum (FWHM)

description.value: T1-weighted MPRAGE images were classified into gray matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid using SPM8 unified segmentation; images were nonlinearly registered to MNI space with DARTEL, bias-corrected and modulated by Jacobian determinants, then smoothed with a 6 mm FWHM isotropic Gaussian kernel to produce smoothed modulated gray matter probability maps for voxel-based morphometry.
